text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Velaris - dedicated-gpu-pool-velaris-prod reporting sustained elevated 5xx rate (4.8% over 5m). Paging SRE oncall: caroline.

caroline: ack - i'm on it. moving to thread. can someone grab pool logs + recent rollout notes for velaris-prod?

alisha: on it, pulling pod logs now. quick note: we saw a config push to the pool ~35m ago (quantization tuning).

devon: fyi I'm watching model infra metrics. getting a spike in model OOM/error loops on hosts gpu-velaris-0{2,3}. KV cache churn up 3x.

taylor: autoscaler also bounced 2x in the last 15m, might be cascaded from errors. digging into scheduler events.

caroline: cse-velaris, can you let customer know we're investigating? no ETA yet but will update in 15m.

cse-velaris: pinged Velaris account team. told them: "We see elevated errors in your dedicated pool; mitigation work in progress. No data compromise. We'll update w/in 15m."

devon: quick mitigation idea: shift a small fraction of Velaris traffic to a lighter, previously validated variant (gptx-mini-safe) while we stabilize the primary variant. low-risk routing change.

alisha: agree. safer than immediate full rollback. any objections to 10% traffic diversion?

taylor: config-wise we can add a route override at the tenant level. example API call:```bash
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routing/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tenant":"velaris","overrides":[{"variant":"gptx-mini-safe","weight":0.10}]}'
```

caroline: go ahead with 10%. infra-bot, apply and report status.

infra-bot: override job queued: id=ovr-8312. targeting velaris-prod, variant=gptx-mini-safe, weight=0.10. estimated apply time ~12s.

infra-bot: override applied. routing change propagated to 3 edge nodes and 6 serving hosts.

devon: seeing immediate drop in error rate on hosts where safe variant took load. overall 5xx rate down to 2.1% across pool. still watching.

ryan: customer slack channel updated: "We routed a small portion of requests to a stable model variant to reduce error rate; continuing to monitor." they asked about permanent changes. advised temporary for now.

alisha: digging into the quantization tuning job: found a one-line miscompile in the tuning branch that affects certain sequence lengths. reproducer attached in logs.

devon: plan: keep 10% diversion, bump to 25% if errors plateau >2m. also prepare a rollback to previous model build if needed.

caroline: handoff - i need to go handle pager rotation in 10m. devon, you'll take lead. alisha you'll stay on metrics and logs, taylor keep an eye on autoscaler. cse-velaris continue customer comms.

devon: taking lead. setting escalation timer 20m. if error rate <1.5% after 10m we'll start a controlled rollback of the quant tuning to the prev build and then remove routing override.

infra-bot: routing override updated: weight=0.25. propagation complete.

devon: after bump to 25%, 5xx rate now 0.7% and latency stable. looks like miscompile + KV churn under specific seq patterns.

alisha: confirmed reproducer. creating PR to revert tuning patch + test on canary. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/quant-tuning/pulls/402

taylor: autoscaler stabilized after hosts recovered. no further flapping observed.

cse-velaris: customer note -> "Appreciate the swift mitigation. Please keep us posted on the rollback timeline and whether this will require any action from us."

devon: recommended next steps for the thread -> revert tuning PR to main after canary pass, monitor for 24h, then gradually remove tenant override (stepwise: 25% -> 10% -> 0%). also create a post-incident eval to add sequence-length unit tests to tuning pipeline.

caroline: thanks team. leaving the thread in devon's hands. if anything regresses @caroline will jump back in. closing pager.

devon: will follow through and post summary + RCA link once PR merges. action items assigned: alisha (PR + canary tests), taylor (confirm autoscaler ops), cse-velaris (customer follow-up), infra (monitor routing metrics).

infra-bot: pager resolved by human: caroline. incident status: mitigated.

devon: summary for record: temporary tenant-level routing override to gptx-mini-safe at 10% then 25% reduced 5xx from 4.8% -> 0.7%. root cause: quant-tuning miscompile affecting specific seq lengths; revert PR created. follow-up: add regression test in tuning pipeline; add an alert for KV cache churn + seq-length correlation.

cse-velaris: customer notified and closing their ticket on our side. they requested a short postmortem once available.

caroline: nice work everyone :tada:
